description: This file implements the CommandDeserializer class, which deserializes various command objects from a data stream for a calculator application. It includes methods to deserialize operand, parentheses, unary, and binary commands, and handles different command types based on an enumeration.

classes.name: CommandDeserializer
classes.description: A class responsible for deserializing command objects from a data stream in the calculator application.

methods.name: Deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes a command object based on the command type enumeration.

methods.name: DeserializeOperand
methods.description: Deserializes an operand command, reading flags and operand vector from the data stream.

methods.name: DeserializeParentheses
methods.description: Deserializes a parentheses command from the data stream.

methods.name: DeserializeUnary
methods.description: Deserializes a unary command, handling different sizes.

methods.name: DeserializeBinary
methods.description: Deserializes a binary command from the data stream.
